bootstrap: storm6.paired_bootstrap: chemical systems resampled with replacement with all their rows; delta = sum of row (|y-P1| - |y-P0|) over sampled rows / number of sampled rows; 1000 draws from numpy default_rng(7); 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles; not selection-adjusted

decision_rule.coverage: at least 90% of cohort rows have all three electronic inputs; otherwise no conclusion about P1 is drawn
decision_rule.main: point delta <= -0.03 K and upper 95% bound < 0: an observed improvement of at least 0.03 K whose interval excludes no improvement; not a 95%-supported improvement of 0.03 K
decision_rule.otherwise: rule not met; or no conclusion when the coverage floor is not met
decision_rule.robustness: after shifting every finite D, geometry and electronic input by +1 ulp, and separately by -1 ulp, and refitting both designs on the same folds, the point delta is <= -0.03 K in both refits (Storm forecasts are sensitive to 1-ulp input changes, and the fixed-forecast bootstrap does not include refit instability)

descriptive_only: Spearman correlation of dos_ef_per_atom with DFT lambda and omega_log (None when undefined)
P0 MAE versus Storm7 U0 (0.9674607593639637 K) as a reproduction check
PM minus P0 and P1 minus PM paired comparisons (missingness control)
Per-design forecast and MAE changes in the +1 and -1 ulp refits (their P1-P0 deltas enter the rule)
Bitwise equality of D, geometry and ID order with the saved Storm7 inputs (storm7_input_sha256)

designs.P0: Unchanged Storm6 R2 raw D+geometry direct Tc (Storm7 U0)
designs.P1: Same plus Alexandria PBE N(E_F) per atom, N(E_F) per cubic angstrom and band gap
designs.PM: Missingness control: P0 plus one 0/1 availability indicator per electronic column, never a value

electronic_inputs.acquisition_evidence: Every raw page is copied into the run directory as soon as it arrives, with an incremental request manifest (url, sha256, bytes, status completed/partial/failed) that survives failures
electronic_inputs.correspondence: Rows bind by Alexandria ID. The alex_supercon structures behind D/geometry equal the Alexandria PBE entries (24/24 sampled IDs; PBEsol entries are separate relaxations). Labels are Quantum ESPRESSO electron-phonon results listed by Alexandria under PBEsol (10.1002/adfm.202404043). Existing and new inputs are PBE descriptors: cross-functional with the labels by construction
electronic_inputs.dos_convention: Alexandria's published value, states/(eV calculation cell); no per-spin split documented; negative values are missing
electronic_inputs.fetch_order: By ID only, after the protocol is frozen and before any target is used for fitting
electronic_inputs.mismatch: All three inputs NaN; the row is kept and its status names the reason
electronic_inputs.missing: NaN, handled natively by HGB; electronic columns missing in every training row of a fold are dropped for that fold
electronic_inputs.snapshot: Every raw OPTIMADE response is kept byte-for-byte with its SHA-256 in the artifact

source.license: Alexandria data, CC BY 4.0 (https://alexandria.icams.rub.de/about.html); attribution kept

structure_check.rule: _alexandria_xc_functional equals the PBE value; nsites equals both site-array lengths; every site fully occupied by one element with a finite concentration of 1; equal species counts; every entry of the lattice metric L L^T agrees within cell_metric_relative times sqrt(G_ii G_jj) (per-axis relative lengths and angles), for some lattice-vector order; every site matched one-to-one to a same-element site under periodic images after at most one rigid origin shift, with the Cartesian residual in both cells within site_angstrom; invariant to rotation, lattice-vector order, site order and origin; other basis changes count as mismatches and their coverage cost is reported
structure_check.uses: IDs and structures only, never labels

estimand: P1 minus P0 on all retained rows compares the pipeline with the Alexandria inputs as available (NaN where unavailable) against the unchanged baseline. It does not by itself attribute a gain to the physical values: PM (P0 plus the per-column availability indicators, which carry every missingness pattern P1 can see but no value) is reported alongside as the missingness control, and a gain is attributed to the values only if P1 also improves on PM. Coverage and mismatch reasons are reported overall, per held-out fold, in the top-10% tail and in the OOD subgroup. The coverage floor is a policy choice
feature_baseline: Exact Storm6 FeatureMap(R2), D+19 geometry; no target components as inputs
head: HistGradientBoostingRegressor on log1p(Tc); expm1 nonnegative clip
head_seed: 7+zero-based outer fold (no effect: no early stopping or subsampling below 10,000 rows)
label_access: Targets only in supervised heads and evaluation; electronic inputs fetched by ID without labels
limitations: Previously inspected folds: exploratory, not independent blind evaluation
N(E_F) of a new candidate needs a DFT calculation; Alexandria provides it for its entries only
N(E_F) is one factor of lambda; electron-phonon matrix elements remain unmodelled
Inputs are PBE ground-state descriptors; labels are PBEsol/Quantum ESPRESSO electron-phonon results
The chemical-system bootstrap does not include refit instability; the two 1-ulp refits probe it but do not bound it; package versions are not pinned
DFT labels and experimental measurements remain separate
numerics: numpy AVX-512 dispatch disabled and OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=Haswell: a mitigation, not validated as guaranteeing equality across hardware; hardware and loaded libraries recorded in the artifact
ood: Unchanged Storm6 D-only nearest different-system training distance, 95th percentile, full outer training set
outer: Unchanged GroupKFold5 chemical-system splits, original row order
package_specification: ml/requirements.txt (lower bounds only; hash above); exact versions recorded in the run, not pinned
primary_comparison: P1 minus P0 material-weighted MAE, 1000 paired chemical-system bootstrap, seed 7
publication: All three designs reported; adopted=false always; no winner or release rule
real_entry_point: A real run reads the reviewed frozen file results/validation/storm8-protocol-v1/protocol.json and compares it with the protocol built in memory before writing anything, refuses an alias to its own output, and refuses to load data unless the bytes are equal; CI compares it as well
secondary: Top-10% target MAE and Storm6 OOD subgroup MAE (paired), electronic-input coverage by status
shifted_forecasts: The P0 and P1 forecasts of both 1-ulp refits are saved per row (shifted-forecasts.csv) as each completes
target: Recomputed simplified Allen-Dynes DFT Tc(K), mu*=0.1,f1=f2=1; not measured Tc
